explication: Mocha is a Node.js and browser test framework. A user invokes the CLI or configures the JavaScript API; Mocha discovers and loads test files, an interface defines suites and tests, and the runner executes them before reporters present results. The repository also supports parallel execution through worker processes and includes browser-specific entry and query/highlighting support. The sampled source directly establishes CLI flag handling, worker dispatch and event buffering; links for other unsampled subsystems follow their named runtime modules and documented roles.
